messages:
alex: Hey team — need a short-lived admin console window (30m) to debug a production deployment that's stuck in CrashLoop and causing 503s for a subset of customers. Incident INC-2026-391.

Can I get console sudo for the `prod-live` namespace only (no DB creds) from 15:30–16:00 UTC? Primary actions: check autoscaler/controller logs, inspect pod state, and trigger a controlled rollback if needed. I will not pull any PII. @maria @sam tagging for visibility. :slightly_smiling_face:

maria: Quick q — can you list the exact commands you need and confirm rollback plan? Prefer exec via bastion with scoped role rather than blanket org-admin. Also add a ticket for audit.

alex: Yes — commands below and I've created a ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1234 (adds justification + rollback plan). Commands I plan to run:

```
# check controller / autoscaler
kubectl -n prod-live get hpa,deploy,rs -o wide
kubectl -n prod-live logs deploy/web-frontend -c autoscaler --since=10m

# inspect failing pod
kubectl -n prod-live describe pod web-frontend-abc123
kubectl -n prod-live logs web-frontend-abc123 -c app --since=30m

# if rollback needed
kubectl -n prod-live rollout undo deploy/web-frontend --to-revision=42
```

I will run everything from my session and log commands to the ticket. No DB queries.

maria: OK that looks scoped. One additional requirement: use the ephemeral role tag `security:ephemeral-access` and set TTL to 30m. I'll only approve once the ticket has the audit blurb (looks like you added it). @ops-bot can you create the short-lived role?

ops-bot: Request received. Creating ephemeral role for alex scoped to `prod-live` namespace, TTL 30 minutes. Will post the exact expiry timestamp when provisioned.

sam: I can shadow and help if rollback is needed. Ping me when you start so I can follow logs.

maria: Approved for 30 minutes. Start window now. Please adhere to the commands above and update the ticket in real-time. If you need to extend beyond 30m, escalate to eng-security with justification.

ops-bot: Access granted to alex (role: ephemeral-prod-live-admin) — expires at 2026-06-17T16:00:00Z. Audit link: https://redwood.internal.audit/ephemeral/1905127890. Reminder: do not access DB credentials.

alex: Thanks all — starting now, I'll post progress to OPS-1234 and close when done.

sam: standing by. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: NOTE: This thread has been recorded for audit purposes.
